snippet.title: Cardboard Conquest - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
I'm the solo dev making Cardboard Conquest, a whimsical game in a cardboard world full of surprises to discover. Play cards, summon an army to fight for you, and watch the battle play out, in between events and mini-games, building your deck, and getting some help from a man-squirrel-hybrid named Uncle Jim.

Wishlist Cardboard Conquest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4937370/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_v7d
Play the free playtest: https://thepaulbooth.itch.io/cardboard-conquest
Discord: https://pbandgames.com/discord

Cardboard Conquest is a roguelike deckbuilding autobattler for 1-4 players that takes place in a beautiful papercraft diorama. It comes to Steam Early Access in March 2027.

#CardboardConquest #roguelike
